name: Nord Express no Satsujin
original_name: ノルド・エクスプレスの殺人
source:
This is a fangame inspired by the 3rd Essence of Season 11, "Unraveling Snow Country." It's a visual novel with elements of mystery and suspense, predominantly about the relationship between the Sheriff (Postman) and the Train Conductor (Gravekeeper).

It's heavily based on the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Murder_on_the_Orient_Express] detective novel that is considered to be the inspiration behind the story of the Essence[/url] and contains spoilers for the original work.

Additionally, the characters' backstories have been altered to better suit the story, and there are lots of headcanons and personal interpretations of these characters' original deductions

[Taken from the [url=https://norusatsu.carrd.co/#desc]official website[/url]]

Identity V fangame.
